_note: v2.5 plan 09 SP9 F1/F2 fixture. Authored witness sets per message (who was in earshot, from the narrative): 24 messages over three scenes (hall, yard, office, hall again), one whispered exchange. Every text carries a unique marker so a request can be searched for it. 'player' is the persona. A speaker always witnesses their own words; the filter never needs the set to say so.

messages.speaker: DM Narrator
messages.text: The guild hall is loud with the evening crowd; a courier waits by the door. [w01]

messages.speaker: player
messages.text: I wave the courier over and take the sealed letter. [w02]

messages.speaker: Arin
messages.text: Arin leans in. That seal is from the harbour office. [w03]

messages.speaker: Ponticius
messages.text: Ponticius frowns. The harbour office owes the guild money. [w04]

messages.speaker: player
messages.text: I break the seal and read it out. [w05]

messages.speaker: DM Narrator
messages.text: The letter asks the guild to guard a shipment leaving at dawn. [w06]

messages.speaker: player
messages.text: I lean close to Arin and whisper that the handwriting is forged. [w07]

messages.speaker: Arin
messages.text: Arin whispers back that she saw the same hand on a fake permit last week. [w08]

messages.speaker: Ponticius
messages.text: Ponticius stands. I will check the ledgers in my office. He leaves the hall. [w09]

messages.speaker: DM Narrator
messages.text: In the yard, the lantern light catches a cart with a broken wheel. [w10]

messages.speaker: player
messages.text: Arin, did you notice the cart carries the harbour mark? [w11]

messages.speaker: Arin
messages.text: I did. And the driver is the courier from the hall. [w12]

messages.speaker: player
messages.text: I tell Arin to keep watch on the driver and head for the office. [w13]

messages.speaker: DM Narrator
messages.text: The office smells of ink; Ponticius has three ledgers open. [w14]

messages.speaker: Ponticius
messages.text: The harbour office paid us last month. This letter is a lie. [w15]

messages.speaker: player
messages.text: I tell Ponticius the handwriting is forged. [w16]

messages.speaker: Ponticius
messages.text: Then someone wants our guards away from the vault at dawn. [w17]

messages.speaker: DM Narrator
messages.text: Outside the window, the broken cart is gone from the yard. [w18]

messages.speaker: player
messages.text: I run back to the hall and call everyone together. [w19]

messages.speaker: Arin
messages.text: Arin arrives breathless. The driver took the cart toward the vault. [w20]

messages.speaker: Ponticius
messages.text: Then we guard the vault, not the shipment. [w21]

messages.speaker: DM Narrator
messages.text: The hall falls quiet as the plan is laid out. [w22]

messages.speaker: player
messages.text: I tell everyone we move at midnight. [w23]

messages.speaker: Arin
messages.text: I will take the back door. [w24]
